activity_summary: You said the news was six days old, and that you had been reading the fairy speech to players while the fire was already out. You took "do not come" and "come for harvest" as one instruction. You kept "none of ours" and dropped the forty. You said you will go on foot. You named no road.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the six days, and stopped on the harvest.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in One thing said twice

facets.activity: Took Anne's two sentences as one instruction

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: She says don't come. She says come for harvest.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That's one thing said twice, if you know her.
